ownership_reason: Only the gold reads the datasets of the plot and decides how many series each dataset index has; hops 1-3 hand the plot and the collection along (hop 1 answers the fixed legend items, hop 2 creates the collection) and hop 4 reads only the series counts the gold returns and the plot's renderers. The variant gold dereferences a null dataset and throws before returning, so no caller can filter or recover the count of a dataset index without a dataset in one line, short of not calling the gold. The gold promises the number of series of each dataset index of the plot, and a CategoryPlot's dataset at an index may be null (getDataset: 'possibly null'; the trigger's Gantt chart is created with a null dataset). The convention that a missing dataset has no series and adds no legend item is pinned outside the gold: AbstractCategoryItemRenderer.getLegendItems (the renderer's own legend items for its dataset index, the series loop only for a dataset that is not null), XYPlot.getLegendItems (the same step for an XYPlot) and DatasetUtilities.isEmptyOrNull(CategoryDataset) ('true if the dataset is empty (or null)'), which CategoryPlot.render uses to skip a null dataset when the plot is drawn; CategoryPlotTests test1654215 requires that a renderer index without a corresponding dataset does not make drawing throw, DatasetUtilitiesTests testIsEmptyOrNullXYDataset that a null dataset counts as empty, and GanttChartTests testReplaceDataset that a null dataset is a regular state of the plot.
